name: wp-real-time-collaboration
description: Pluggable real-time collaboration engines and transports for the Gutenberg collaborative-editing framework.

scripts.env:tests:stop: WP_RTC_WP_ENV_CONFIG=.wp-env.tests.json npm run redis:stop && wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json stop
scripts.preplayground: test -f build/wp-rtc.js -a -d gutenberg/build || { echo "playground: build first (npm run build; cd gutenberg && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build)" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.redis:destroy: REDIS_PROJECT=$(npm run --silent redis:project) && REDIS_NAME="$REDIS_PROJECT-redis" && docker info >/dev/null && if docker container inspect "$REDIS_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm -f "$REDIS_NAME"; fi
scripts.redis:start: REDIS_PROJECT=$(npm run --silent redis:project) && REDIS_NAME="$REDIS_PROJECT-redis" && (docker start "$REDIS_NAME" 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --rm --name "$REDIS_NAME" --network "${REDIS_PROJECT}_default" --network-alias sync-redis redis:7.4-alpine redis-server --save "" --appendonly no) && REDIS_ATTEMPTS=0 && until docker exec "$REDIS_NAME" redis-cli ping; do REDIS_ATTEMPTS=$((REDIS_ATTEMPTS + 1)); [ "$REDIS_ATTEMPTS" -lt 15 ] || exit 1; sleep 1; done
scripts.redis:stop: REDIS_PROJECT=$(npm run --silent redis:project) && REDIS_NAME="$REDIS_PROJECT-redis" && docker info >/dev/null && if docker container inspect "$REDIS_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker stop "$REDIS_NAME"; fi
